newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, no bids posted on front month.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, no bids posted on front month.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Wednesday morning - the first session this week to go without trade after two unusually active days on Monday and Tuesday.
Front month August was offered at 9.65 pence a therm at the close of the session, but no bids were seen for August or September.
Both bids and offers were posted for the six months from October 1997 to March 1998, but after March the market was bid but not offered.
On Monday 450 lots were traded, with 310 done on Tuesday. Volumes on the futures market have been erratic and unpredictable since the start of the contract in January.
